chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from someone else from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

He said regarding a man who marries a woman and finds 'qarn' in her, which is al-'afal (inability to copulate due to uterine horns), or vitiligo, or leprosy, that he can return her as long as he has not entered (consummated) with her.

key_terms.الْعَفَل: Inability to copulate due to uterine horns
key_terms.دَخَلَ بِهَا: He entered with her (consummated the marriage)
key_terms.قَرْن: Uterine horns; a physical defect in women

ai.seo_question: What are the valid reasons for a husband to return his wife before consummation according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the right of *khiyar al-'ayb* (option of defect) specifically for physical conditions like 'afal' (uterine anomaly), vitiligo, or leprosy discovered prior to consummation. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the importance of transparency in marriage contracts, allowing the husband to annul the union without financial penalty if the defect was not disclosed or expected.

en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from someone else, from Aban Bin Usman, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said regarding the man who had married the woman, so he found uterine horns with her, and it is Al Afal (inability to copulate due to uterine horns), or vitiligo, or leprosy, that he can return her for as long as he has not copulated with her’.
en.sarwar: 12. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from more than one person from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from ‘ Abd af-Rahman ibn abu ‘ Abd Allah who has said the following: “

About the case of a man who marries a woman and finds Qarn or al- ‘Afal (growth of a substance in her vagina that prevents sexual intercourse) with her or whiteness or leprosy, he (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that he can revoke the marriage if he has not gone to bed with her.’”
